description: Defines the 'uplink_processor_fsm' class implementing a finite-state machine for uplink processing, including state management, slot handling, and PDU/PRACH task tracking within a radio communication system.

classes.name: uplink_processor_fsm
classes.description: Finite-state machine managing uplink PDU processing states, slot configuration, and task coordination.

classes.name: uplink_processor_fsm_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the FSM about PDU count changes and acceptance status.

methods.name: start_new_slot
methods.description: Transitions FSM to accepting state for a specified slot.

methods.name: has_receive_request
methods.description: Checks if the processor has receive requests for a given slot.

methods.name: stop_accepting_pdu
methods.description: Removes accepting mask, indicating no longer accepting PDUs.

methods.name: increment_pending_pdu_count
methods.description: Increments pending PDU count, indicating new PDU arrival.

methods.name: start_discard_slot
methods.description: Begins discarding slot process if conditions allow.

methods.name: finish_discard_slot
methods.description: Completes slot discard, resetting state to idle.

methods.name: start_handle_rx_symbol
methods.description: Begins handling a receive symbol, locking the FSM.

methods.name: finish_handle_rx_symbol
methods.description: Ends handling a receive symbol, unlocking the FSM.

methods.name: on_create_pdu_task
methods.description: Indicates creation of a new PDU processing task.

methods.name: on_finish_processing_pdu
methods.description: Indicates completion of a PDU processing task.

methods.name: on_prach_detection
methods.description: Requests increment of PRACH detection task counter.

methods.name: on_end_prach_detection
methods.description: Indicates completion of a PRACH detection task.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops the FSM, waiting for ongoing tasks to finish.
